description: Defines the ClusterStatus class which models the status of an Akka cluster, including reachable and unreachable members, leader, roles, and serialization to JSON.

classes.name: ClusterStatus
classes.description: Immutable class representing the status of an Akka cluster, including members, leader, roles, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ClusterStatus instance with specified cluster state details.

methods.name: getReachable
methods.description: Returns the set of reachable cluster members.

methods.name: getUnreachable
methods.description: Returns the set of unreachable cluster members.

methods.name: getSeenBy
methods.description: Returns the set of members that have seen this cluster state.

methods.name: getLeader
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the leader address, if present.

methods.name: getOwnRoles
methods.description: Returns the set of roles this cluster member has.

methods.name: getRoles
methods.description: Returns the set of ClusterRoleStatus objects representing roles and their statuses.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the ClusterStatus object to a JSON representation.
